beats.say: Walter Koenig passed away on Sunday 25 October at age 90.
The Chicago born actor became a global icon as Ensign Pavel Chekov in the original Star Trek series.
According to one source, he was one of only two actors to audition for that legendary role.
He studied in New York alongside future stars James Caan and Christopher Lloyd before joining the Enterprise.
The BBC reports he won a best actor award just this year for the film Mr Fleischmann.
His sixty year friendship with George Takei was so close that Koenig served as his best man.
This lifelong bond shows how the show's unity was real, even decades after the cameras stopped rolling.
Walter Koenig passed away on Sunday 25 October at age 90.

facts: Walter Koenig died on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at the age of 90.
Koenig was born in Chicago, Illinois.
He played Pavel Chekov starting in the second season of Star Trek.
He was one of only two actors to audition for the role.
He studied with James Caan and Christopher Lloyd.
He won a best actor award at the 2026 Independent Shorts Awards.
He was the best man at George Takei's wedding.
